caption:
Same price. Hit 4 times. It's an ICEBERG. 🧊

Sellers kept hitting 24,480 with market orders: 1,450 contracts traded there, while the DOM never showed more than 60 on the bid. That gap is a passive buyer refilling a hidden limit order. Aggression that can't move price one tick isn't strength, it's being absorbed.

1️⃣ Volume piles up at one price on the footprint
2️⃣ Traded size far above the displayed bid, and price won't trade through
3️⃣ Enter on the reclaim, invalidate one tick below the iceberg
